label: Banana value-added products
about: Chips, raw-banana flour, health mixes and dried banana from the Tiruchirappalli banana belt (Thottiyam, Musiri), where unsold and B-grade fruit is otherwise sold cheap.

questions.ask: Which banana products do you want to start with?
Small retail pouches, family packs, or bulk for bakeries and caterers?
Will you process in your own unit, or use a food co-packer at first?
How many packs a month do you expect to sell in the first year?

formats.bulk: Bulk packs for bakeries and caterers

nendran_raw.label: Raw Nendran banana
nendran_raw.sourcing: Growers and FPOs around Thottiyam and Musiri; contract a share of the harvest at an agreed price band

green_banana.label: Raw green banana (Monthan or Karpooravalli)
green_banana.sourcing: Same belt; B-grade fruit is fine for flour

coconut_oil.sourcing: Coimbatore and Pollachi oil mills; buy in tins with a certificate of analysis

jaggery.sourcing: Jaggery units in the Cauvery delta and western Tamil Nadu

costing_defaults.format_lever: Sell bulk to bakeries and caterers alongside retail pouches
costing_defaults.label: Example figures for a first estimate. Replace with your own quotes; nothing here is a market price.

regulatory.title: FSSAI registration or licence by turnover
regulatory.text: Basic registration up to ₹12 lakh annual turnover; State licence above that (up to ₹20 crore); Central licence above. Apply on FoSCoS.

regulatory.title: Frying oil quality limit
regulatory.text: Used frying oil must not exceed 25% total polar compounds; FSSAI expects large fryers to track oil use and dispose of spent oil properly.

regulatory.title: Nutrition and allergen labelling
regulatory.text: Packaged foods carry nutrition information and declarations under the FSSAI labelling and display regulations.

regulatory.title: Legal Metrology declarations
regulatory.text: Pre-packed goods carry name and address, net quantity, MRP, date and customer-care details.

templates.title: Choose the starting product line and its buyer
deliverables: {n_variants} products chosen
Which are fried snacks and which are dried products
Who buys: households, bakeries, caterers, health shops
templates.why: The line decides your raw fruit, equipment and licences.

templates.title: Process trials and measure your yield
deliverables: Slicing, frying or drying trials for each product
Yield: raw kg needed per kg finished
Moisture and crispness targets

deliverables.text: Frying-oil plan: oil choice, reuse limit, disposal
Drying method: solar dryer or electric dryer, drying time per batch

templates.why: Yield decides cost more than any other number; measure it before you price.

templates.title: Taste and price tests with buyers
deliverables: 30+ tasters per product
Bakeries or caterers asked for bulk needs
Price they would pay
templates.why: Shows which products to keep before you commit to fruit contracts.

templates.title: Secure raw banana and oil supply
deliverables: Supply agreement with 3+ growers or an FPO
Price band across the year (prices swing with the season)
Second source for oil and other inputs
templates.why: Raw fruit is most of your cost and swings with the season; contracts smooth both.

templates.title: Cost every pack using your measured yield
deliverables: Cost sheet per product with your yield and quotes
Ex-factory, distributor and retail prices
Cost-cutting levers chosen
templates.why: Shows which products make money at your real yield.

templates.title: FSSAI {fssai_tier}, lab tests and labels
deliverables: FSSAI application on FoSCoS; number for labels
Lab tests at an NABL-accredited food lab and shelf-life study
Nutrition, allergen and Legal Metrology declarations

deliverables.text: Frying-oil quality records (total polar compounds within the FSSAI limit)

templates.why: No food can be sold without FSSAI; the tier follows your projected turnover.

templates.title: Packaging and labels
deliverables: {format_label} chosen
Nitrogen flushing for chips (keeps them crisp and stops breakage)
Artwork with mandatory declarations
First print run at minimum order quantity
templates.why: Chips go stale and break without the right pouch; packaging is your second-largest cost.

templates.title: Pilot batch with a food co-packer
deliverables: Co-packer with an FSSAI licence for your product category
Pilot batch of each product
Quality checks against your trial targets
templates.why: Low fixed cost while volumes are small.

templates.title: Set up a small processing unit
deliverables: Premises meeting FSSAI hygiene rules
Slicer, peeler and fryer or dryer, pulveriser, sealer, weighing

deliverables.text: Solar dryer to cut drying energy cost

deliverables: First production batch

applies.label: you process in your own unit

templates.why: Higher fixed cost; pays off above the break-even volume in your cost sheet.

templates.title: Launch in your first channels

deliverables.text: Own store page and marketplace listings
A distributor in your district and listings in 20 shops
Bulk supply to bakeries, caterers and hotels

applies.label: you sell to bakeries and caterers

deliverables: Repeat-purchase tracking by product
templates.why: Real sales by product and channel replace guesses.

deliverables: 100 repeat buyers
Sales by product and season
Line cut or extended (see free extensions)
